ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider (Ryde voucher per NS-7) and remind the driver that the "I'm Here" tap plus >3 min waiting at the pickup point is a precondition for a rider no-show fee; record the cancellation against the driver's cancellation rate.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's chat claim of waiting more than 3 minutes is contradicted by the timeline: within-200m time was 2 min 30 s and cancellation came 2 min 30 s after recorded arrival (NS-1(iii) not met; system records override statements).
Driver's statement that he pressed 'I'm Here' is contradicted by the timeline fact that driver_pressed_here_at is null (NS-1(i) not met).
